hypotheses: Three entries fit three prefixes only if the byte budget also fits. A byte limit fitting two prefixes should restore thrashing despite max_entries=3.
No positive speedup is required. Nine hits should remove repeated prefix work, not accelerate decode kernels.
Injected builder/clone/invalid-size failures must preserve residents, LRU and success counters; only failures increases. Callback mutation/reentrancy and concurrent callers are outside contract.
timing: Pretokenized serial batch1; 8 forced greedy tokens. Two warmups per prefix per mode. Randomized mode order per round. Total includes first misses. No model load, tokenization, network, queueing or tail-latency claim.
